description:
A processing component that connects to a FalkorDB graph database. 
Accepts natural-language questions, translates them to Cypher queries 
via an LLM, and returns results to the pipeline. Also exposes the graph 
to an agent as a tool. Queries are read-only by default, enforced by the server.

llm.description: LLM to use to craft Cypher queries from question

allow_execute.description: Enable the execute tool, which runs raw Cypher with no LLM translation and no read-only gate. Leave OFF unless a trusted application explicitly needs to issue Cypher directly.
allow_execute.title: Allow Execute

allow_writes.description: Permit CREATE/MERGE/SET/DELETE in the query tool. When off, queries run via GRAPH.RO_QUERY and the server itself rejects write clauses.
allow_writes.title: Allow Writes

db_description.description: What is this graph used for? Describe its content and domain, this helps the LLM generate more accurate Cypher queries.
db_description.title: Graph Description

graph.description: A FalkorDB server hosts many graphs. This is the one queried when the caller does not name another.
graph.title: Default Graph

host.description: FalkorDB host, e.g. localhost or your-instance.falkordb.cloud.
host.title: Host

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of times to re-ask the LLM if EXPLAIN rejects the generated Cypher query.
max_attempts.title: Max Validation Attempts

max_execute_rows.description: Upper cap on rows returned by the execute tool. The query fails if exceeded, so one statement cannot exhaust worker memory.
max_execute_rows.title: Max Execute Rows

max_rows.description: Upper cap on rows returned per query. Results beyond it are cut and flagged as truncated.
max_rows.title: Max Rows

password.description: Password for the FalkorDB instance. Leave empty for no auth.
password.title: Password

port.description: FalkorDB port (Redis protocol). FalkorDB Cloud assigns a per-instance port.
port.title: Port

query_timeout_ms.description: Server-side timeout for a single query.
query_timeout_ms.title: Query Timeout (ms)

tls.description: Connect with TLS. Required by FalkorDB Cloud TLS endpoints.
tls.title: TLS

username.description: Username, e.g. "default" for FalkorDB Cloud. Leave empty for no auth.
username.title: Username

title: FalkorDB
